project_type: Python stdlib HTTP server (backend) + vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend with Three.js (CDN importmap)
build_system: None (stdlib Python server, no build step, Three.js from CDN via importmap)
test_framework: Python unittest, test files in backend/tests/test_*.py
verification_instructions: Run python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' and confirm all tests pass (currently 400 pass)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.9+ available. No npm/node build needed. Three.js loaded from CDN.
key_patterns: Backend: handlers in backend/api/handlers.py return Tuple[int, dict]. Routes registered in backend/main.py do_GET/do_POST. Services in backend/services/. Frontend: pages use importmap for Three.js (three@0.160.0 from jsdelivr CDN). Dark theme 'Solar Pro' with CSS variables in frontend/css/style.css. Step navigation bar pattern in report.html. localStorage used for state between pages (instalacja_config, budynek_config, lokalizacja, parcel_vertices).
directory_structure: backend/ (main.py, api/handlers.py, services/*.py, tests/test_*.py, data/*.json, models/). frontend/ (index.html, viewer.html, pages/*.html, js/*.js, css/*.css).
